body:
There are quite a few times where the shortest path takes me to a ladder or staircase that is against a wall.
The route itself looks shorter, but it brings me to the wrong side of the object, so I cannot actually interact with it.
I took a quick look through the code, and I think it may be related to the blocked transport handling in CollisionMap.getTileNeighbors():
https://github.com/Skretzo/shortest-path/blob/master/src/main/java/shortestpath/pathfinder/CollisionMap.java#L203-L219
I may be reading it wrong, but it looks like this section checks whether a blocked adjacent tile has a transport starting from it and then adds that transport origin to the route.
I do not see anything there confirming that the player is approaching from a side where the ladder or staircase can actually be used.
So it seems like the pathfinder proves that it can reach a tile next to the transport, but not necessarily that it can interact with the transport from that particular side.
I do not think the answer is simply applying normal collision checks to every blocked transport, because this behavior is probably needed for things like fairy rings and portals.
It may need to check which side of the transport can actually be interacted with, reject the invalid approach, and then calculate the next-shortest valid route.
Another possibility is that some of the transport origins in transports.tsv need to be updated with the correct approach tiles.
A regression test could use a blocked ladder tile with a wall on one side and a valid approach on another. The shorter blocked approach should be rejected, while the valid side should still produce a working route.
The main files that seemed relevant from a quick look were:
src/main/java/shortestpath/pathfinder/CollisionMap.java
src/main/java/shortestpath/pathfinder/Pathfinder.java
src/main/java/shortestpath/transport/Transport.java
src/main/resources/transports/transports.tsv
src/test/java/shortestpath/pathfinder/PathfinderTest.java
I can provide specific in-game examples, coordinates, screenshots, and proposed code or unit tests if that would be helpful.
title: Shortest path sometimes approaches ladders or stairs from the wrong side

Hi, would be great if the POH section had further available tweaks ; 

Currently one level of portal nexus is supported and assumes you have all locations unlocked, would love to be able to select which portals I have unlocked at this time.

Same for mounted items, it's currently either ALL of them, or none of them. A xeric talisman is much easier to setup than a myth cape for example.. 

Thanks! :)

comments.body:
I have laid the groundwork for Portal Nexus key bind support in #536. This includes a list of unlocked portals saved for each player such that we can trace back the key binds across different login sessions.

From this config, we could automatically deduce which portals are valid teleport options.
